Tiptap WYSIWYG editor with
markdown shortcuts. Owns
paragraph-anchor timestamps.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Live-appending transcript
view, with the live audio
meter rendered above it.
Per-segment speaker chip with
a live colour dot
(deterministic speaker_id ->
palette slot) when
diarization labels are
present. Read-only; emits
hover/click cross-reference
events.
